newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Six groups to bid for Brazil Coelba - paper.
newsitem.headline: Six groups to bid for Brazil Coelba - paper.

text.p: Six consortia will bid at the July 31 privatization auction of Bahia state power distributor Coelba, Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper reported Tuesday.

The different groups include foreign firms such as U.S. power operators Florida Power, CMS Energy and CSW; Spanish group Iberdrola Investimentos Sociedade Unipessoal LDA, and local privatized firms Light, Escelsa and Cerj, the paper said.
Gazeta said sources close to the consortia forecast that Coelba may be sold 30 percent to 40 percent above its base price of 975.8 million reais.
The Brazilian state of Bahia will sell 9.8 billion common shares or 65.64 percent of Coelba's voting capital in a closed-envelope auction on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange.
